items.title: Product Owner - Sportsbook
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About UXMatrix UXMatrix develops a broad range of digital products, including bespoke frontend applications, reusable templates, widgets, APIs, automated quality-assurance solutions, and a fully customizable WordPress-based CMS. Our products serve multiple operators, brands, and regulated markets, requiring us to balance customer needs, end-user experience, technical scalability, regulatory requirements, and commercial value. About the Role We are looking for a Sportsbook Product Owner to join the UXMatrix Product Team and take ownership of the development and continuous improvement of our sportsbook frontend experience. You will define what should be built and why, translating customer, market, and business needs into clear product outcomes and actionable requirements for the development team. You will work closely with design, engineering, QA, delivery, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, and operators throughout the complete product lifecycle—from discovery and definition through delivery, launch, measurement, and optimization. The ideal candidate combines strong product thinking with an understanding of sportsbook user journeys, frontend technology, data, and agile delivery. You should be comfortable making decisions, challenging assumptions, managing competing priorities, and maintaining a clear product direction in a fast-paced environment. What You'll get to do: Product Vision and Strategy Define and communicate the product vision, strategy, objectives, and roadmap for the sportsbook frontend. Translate company strategy, operator requirements, market trends, and end-user needs into clear product priorities. Identify opportunities to improve sportsbook acquisition, engagement, conversion, retention, and overall user experience. Balance reusable product capabilities with operator-specific and market-specific requirements. Contribute to the long-term evolution of the sportsbook product, including personalization, modularity, scalability, and multi-tenant capabilities. Clearly articulate the business and customer value behind proposed initiatives. Product Discovery and Requirements Work with operators, commercial teams, internal stakeholders, and end users to identify problems, needs, and product opportunities. Analyze sportsbook journeys such as event discovery, navigation, search, market selection, bet placement, betslip usage, live betting, promotions, and bet management. Convert business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and functional specifications. Break down complex initiatives into manageable and independently deliverable increments. Validate requirements with design, engineering, QA, platform teams, and relevant stakeholders before development begins. Ensure regulatory, responsible-gambling, accessibility, localization, and market-specific requirements are considered during product definition. Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible product documentation in Jira and Confluence. Roadmap and Prioritization Own and continuously maintain the product backlog. Prioritize initiatives and backlog items based on customer value, user impact, commercial potential, strategic alignment, risk, effort, and technical dependencies. Define minimum viable product scope and phased-delivery approaches for larger initiatives. Manage scope throughout the delivery lifecycle and ensure material changes are assessed, documented, and agreed with the appropriate stakeholders. Balance new product development, operator requirements, technical improvements, defects, and technical-debt reduction. Make clear prioritization decisions when capacity or timelines are constrained. Agile Delivery Work closely with engineering, design, and QA throughout planning, refinement, development, testing, and release. Ensure the development team understands the product objectives, user needs, requirements, and expected outcomes. Lead or actively contribute to backlog refinement, sprint planning, reviews, and relevant product workshops. Provide timely clarification and make product decisions during development. Identify dependencies, risks, and blockers early and collaborate with the appropriate owners to resolve them. Accept completed work based on agreed requirements and acceptance criteria. Support release planning and ensure features are ready from a product, operational, documentation, and stakeholder perspective. Maintain delivery transparency and communicate progress, risks, scope changes, and decisions clearly. Stakeholder and Client Management Act as the primary product contact for assigned sportsbook initiatives. Build strong working relationships with operators, sportsbook platform teams, commercial stakeholders, engineering, UX, QA, delivery, and senior management. Facilitate product workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, demonstrations, and roadmap discussions. Set clear expectations regarding product scope, priorities, dependencies, and delivery assumptions. Evaluate stakeholder requests objectively and challenge solutions that do not support the product strategy or provide sufficient customer value. Present recommendations using evidence, product data, competitive analysis, and clearly structured business arguments. Support client presentations, product demonstrations, sales opportunities, and RFP responses when required. Product Performance and Continuous Improvement Define success criteria and measurable KPIs for new features and product initiatives. Monitor sportsbook metrics such as event-to-bet conversion, betslip completion, bet placement success, click-through rates, engagement, bet frequency, retention, and feature adoption. Use quantitative data, qualitative feedback, user research, and operational insights to evaluate product performance. Review delivered features after launch and identify opportunities for optimization. Work with UX and analytics teams to identify friction, abandonment points, usability issues, and unmet customer needs. Maintain awareness of sportsbook market developments, competitor products, user-experience patterns, and emerging technologies. Conduct competitor and feature-comparison analysis to identify meaningful product differentiators. Propose improvements that strengthen the UXMatrix sportsbook proposition and create measurable value for EveryMatrix clients. What we’re looking for: At least three years of experience in product ownership, product management, business analysis, or a comparable digital-product role. Experience in iGaming. Experience working with cross-functional software-development teams in an agile environment. Strong ability to translate business and user needs into clear, structured, and testable product requirements. Demonstrated experience managing product backlogs, priorities, scope, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to make evidence-based product decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Confidence presenting product recommendations and reasoning with technical, commercial, and senior stakeholders. Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives and competing priorities. Ability to understand technical concepts, frontend architecture, APIs, integrations, and platform dependencies at a product level. Experience using Jira, Confluence, or equivalent product and delivery-management tools. Professional proficiency in English. A degree in technology, economics, business, or a related discipline. What Success Looks Like Success in this role means establishing a clear and evidence-based direction for the sportsbook frontend, maintaining a well-prioritized and delivery-ready backlog, improving collaboration between product and engineering, and delivering measurable improvements for operators and sportsbook users. You will be expected to create alignment around what we build, why we build it, and how we determine whether it has been successful. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

items.title: Engineering Manager, International
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The International engineering team's mission is to expand Robinhood's products globally and scale our platform to support millions of new customers in diverse markets. We build and maintain experiences across onboarding, funding, account setup, localized product experiences, growth incentives, and platform capabilities to operate in new jurisdictions. Our engineering team partners closely with product, design, compliance, marketing teams, along with an array of platform engineering teams to launch new products and optimize user acquisition globally. We prioritize technical rigor, system reliability, and quick execution to deliver reliable products to our growing customer base. Our culture is centered on clear communication, strong team partnership, and a commitment to helping people manage their financial lives! As an Engineering Manager , you will lead a team of software developers to drive some of Robinhood’s most important international launch initiatives. You will be responsible for driving the architecture and execution required to launch crypto and other financial products in new regions, while shaping the reusable systems that make future launches faster, safer, and more scalable. You will guide technical execution, review system architectures, and ensure our services remain highly performant and secure at scale. In this role, you will recruit, mentor, and support the career progression of engineers on your team. You will work closely with product managers, compliance partners, and other team leads to define technical strategy and deliver features on schedule. Your leadership will directly shape how we scale our platform and deliver a reliable financial experience to our global community! This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week . At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Team Leadership & Development: Lead and support your team of developers, providing clear goals, regular feedback, and structured growth plans. Technical Strategy: Define technical direction and prioritize work with product managers and partner teams to scale our international products and systems. Architecture & Performance: Ensure backend services and localized products are designed for high availability, performance, and security. Talent Management: Manage hiring, onboarding, and performance evaluations for engineers on your team. Collaboration & Execution: Coordinate with product, design, and other engineering leads to deliver critical initiatives on schedule and meet defined business metrics. What you bring Experience: 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 2 years of experience managing engineering teams. Product Shipping Experience: Proven experience leading collaborative teams across product, design, and engineering to ship complex products, including end-to-end management from concept to launch, and ensuring high-quality, reliable user experiences post-deployment. Systems Design: Experience designing and operating distributed systems with a focus on reliability, scalability, and performance. Project Delivery: Experience delivering complex technical projects from initial planning through execution and deployment. Communication: Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and business partners to explain technical decisions and trade-offs. Mentorship: Experience supporting team development through regular coaching, mentoring, and feedback. Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here’s what we expect from them: Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech. Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly. Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. items.title: Product Data Analyst – User Behavior & Analytics
items.description: About us EveryMatrix is a leading B2B SaaS provider delivering iGaming software, content and services. We provide casino, sports betting, platform and payments, and affiliate management to 300 customers worldwide. But that's not all! We're not just about numbers, we're about people. With a team of over 1400 passionate individuals spread across twelve countries in Europe and Asia, we're all united by our love for innovation and teamwork. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to redefine the iGaming landscape, one groundbreaking solution at a time. About the Role We are looking for a Product Data Analyst to join the UXMatrix Product Team and help establish a consistent, evidence-based approach to product development and optimization. You will define how product performance and user behaviour are measured, ensure that the necessary data is collected accurately, and transform that data into insights and recommendations that Product Owners, UX Designers, Engineering teams, and business stakeholders can act upon. This role extends beyond dashboard creation and regular reporting. You will investigate user journeys, identify friction and opportunities, support product discovery, define feature-success criteria, and determine whether released initiatives achieve their intended customer and business outcomes. You will work across UXMatrix products, with a particular focus on critical frontend journeys such as registration, login, deposit, sportsbook navigation, event discovery, bet placement, casino discovery, promotions, content interaction, and customer retention. What You'll get to do: Product Measurement Strategy Work with Product Owners and stakeholders to translate business objectives into measurable product outcomes and KPIs. Establish clear success criteria before features and initiatives enter development. Define leading and lagging indicators across acquisition, activation, engagement, conversion, retention, and feature adoption. Help product teams distinguish between activity metrics, diagnostic metrics, and measurable customer or business outcomes. Ensure product recommendations are supported by reliable data, user research, or clearly documented hypotheses. Analytics Tracking and Data Quality Define and maintain analytics tracking plans for websites, applications, widgets, and critical user journeys. Translate business questions and measurement objectives into clear technical tracking requirements. Validate analytics implementations before and after release. Monitor data quality and investigate broken events, incomplete parameters, unexpected changes, and reporting discrepancies. Ensure that tracking implementations comply with consent, privacy, security, and applicable regulatory requirements. Product and User-Behaviour Analysis Identify abandonment points, friction, behavioural patterns, and opportunities for improvement. Segment users according to relevant characteristics such as acquisition source, device, market, lifecycle stage, product preference, engagement level, or previous behaviour. Conduct funnel, cohort, retention, conversion, path, and behavioural analyses. Analyze critical user journeys Combine quantitative data with UX research, customer feedback, technical performance, and operational context. Reporting and Data Visualization Build and maintain dashboards that provide stakeholders with a clear view of product performance. Create reporting views appropriate for Product Owners, UX teams, Engineering teams, operators, commercial stakeholders, and senior management. Present trends, anomalies, risks, and opportunities clearly and concisely. Reduce dependency on manual reporting by developing reusable and automated dashboards. Ensure KPI definitions remain consistent across products, teams, and reports. Deliver focused analysis and actionable recommendations rather than reporting data without interpretation. Product Discovery and Decision Support Support Product Owners during product discovery by evaluating evidence, sizing opportunities, and identifying behavioural problems. Provide data to support roadmap prioritization, business cases, and investment decisions. Help product teams formulate measurable hypotheses for proposed product changes. Challenge assumptions and stakeholder requests when they are not supported by evidence or a clearly defined customer problem. Conduct market, benchmark, and competitor analyses when relevant to product decisions. Contribute relevant data and insights to product reviews, client presentations, RFP responses, and strategic discussions. Experimentation and Feature Evaluation Define hypotheses, success metrics, guardrail metrics, and evaluation criteria for product experiments. Support A/B tests, controlled rollouts, phased releases, and other product-validation methods. Conduct post-launch reviews to determine whether delivered features achieved their intended outcomes. Track whether recommendations lead to product changes and measurable improvements. Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with Product Owners, UX Designers, Developers, QA Engineers, Architects, BI teams, operators, and commercial stakeholders. Facilitate workshops to define business questions, KPIs, success criteria, and tracking requirements. Proactively identify relevant insights rather than working exclusively from reporting requests. Establish a regular product-insight cadence through reviews, reporting, and focused deep-dive analyses. Keep stakeholders informed about measurement gaps, data-quality risks, and significant product-performance changes. What we’re looking for: At least three years of experience in product analytics, digital analytics, business intelligence, data analysis, or a comparable analytical role. Previous experience in sportsbook, iGaming, gaming, fintech, e-commerce, or another transactional or regulated digital industry. Strong SQL skills and experience extracting, combining, validating, and analyzing data from multiple sources. Experience analyzing digital-product behaviour, including user journeys, conversion, engagement, feature adoption, and retention. Experience defining analytics events, parameters, tracking plans, event taxonomies, and measurement frameworks. Practical experience with analytics and visualization tools such as GA4, Microsoft Clarity, Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, Mixpanel, or equivalent platforms. Ability to transform complex data into clear findings and actionable product recommendations. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present findings to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong attention to detail and a disciplined approach to data quality and validation. Experience collaborating with Product, UX, Engineering, QA, BI, and commercial teams. Good understanding of web and mobile application behaviour, including client-side and server-side tracking. Professional proficiency in English. A degree in statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics, business, or another relevant discipline. Here's what we offer: Start with 22 days of annual leave, with 2 additional days added each year, up to 32 days by your fifth year with us. Benefit from two Free Fridays each year, limited to one per quarter. 3 sick leave days per year, no doctor's note required. Daily catered lunch or monthly lunch allowance. Private Medical Subscription. Access online learning platforms like Udemy for Business and LinkedIn Learning, and a budget for external training. Access to an Employee Assistance Program through TELUS Health. Our office perks include parking, on-site massages, and frequent team-building activities in various locations. And did we mention our amazing office space complete with its own pool and gym? At EveryMatrix, we're committed to creating a supportive and inclusive workplace where you can thrive both personally and professionally. Come join us and experience the difference! EveryMatrix is a member of the World Lottery Association (WLA) and European Lotteries Association. In September 2023 it became the first iGaming supplier to receive WLA Safer Gambling Certification. EveryMatrix is proud of its commitment to safer gambling and player protection whilst producing market leading gaming solutions.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Compute Solution Architect, you will support our strategic AI Infrastructure customers. In this role, you will be a trusted technical advisor, helping clients design, deploy, and scale AI solutions while managing large-scale GPU workloads involving thousands of GPUs. You will also collaborate with sales and product teams to drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction. WHAT YOU WILL DO Your responsibilities will include: - Serve as the primary technical point of contact, troubleshooting and resolving for AI Infrastructure services. - Lead the delivery of strategic GPUaaS contracts and ensure all commitments are met (timelines, SLAs, support, …). - Act as a bridge to product and support teams, providing customer feedback, relaying feature requests, and ensuring alignment with customer requirements. - Guide customers in optimizing GPU performance for ML training and inference workloads, ensuring seamless integration and scalability. - Partner with the sales team to identify new opportunities, promote the latest products, and deliver technical presentations. NICE TO HAVE - Working knowledge of model training frameworks runtimes (e.g., PyTorch, JAX, Tensorflow) and Generative AI serving runtimes (e.g., vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, TGI, LLM-D). - Proficiency with parallel file systems (e.g., Lustre, GPFS) and object storage integration. - Familiarity with high-performance infrastructure: InfiniBand/RDMA networking, parallel storage, and multi-node distributed training topologies. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS Compute deals require flawless execution from the initial technical commitment through deployment and production. By coordinating customers, sales, product, and support, the Compute Solution Architect ensures that infrastructure performs as expected, contractual commitments and SLAs are met, and issues are resolved quickly. This end-to-end ownership is critical to building customer trust, securing long-term adoption, and turning strategic GPUaaS contracts into successful partnerships. items.title: Senior Software Engineer, Tokenization
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Tokenization team's mission is to bring both public and private equity to be tradable 24/7 on decentralized exchanges (DEXs) across the Robinhood Chain. We work at the intersection of blockchain technology, financial market infrastructure, and modern distributed systems - with a focus on accessibility, security, and scalability. Equity markets have been closed nights and weekends for a century; we're building the infrastructure that changes that. As a Senior Software Engineer , you will design and build the core systems that issue, custody, and settle tokenized equities on-chain and keep them in sync with traditional brokerage and ledger systems. You'll lead technically complex projects end to end, make architectural decisions on a foundational Robinhood initiative, and work in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable - the systems you build move real customer assets, continuously, across multiple chains and jurisdictions. This role is based in our Toronto, ON office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week . At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Design, build, and operate the backend services that mint, custody, and settle tokenized equities across leading blockchains, with correctness and auditability as hard requirements Own large, technically complex projects end to end - design, implementation, rollout, and operating what you ship in a 24/7 system Build the connective tissue between traditional market infrastructure (brokerage, ledgers, corporate actions) and on-chain systems, including smart contract integrations, chain indexers, and DEX trade flows Partner with product, compliance, legal, and platform teams to turn regulatory constraints into workable system design Raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship What you bring 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including a track record of delivering large-scale distributed systems in production Expertise in backend development with Go, Python, or Java, and deep familiarity with cloud-native architecture (Kafka, Postgres, Kubernetes, or equivalents) Strong instincts for correctness-critical systems - idempotency, reconciliation, and reasoning carefully about failure modes when money is at stake Demonstrated ownership of ambiguous, cross-functional projects, with the judgment to make tradeoffs and drive alignment Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical direction beyond your own projects Working knowledge of blockchain fundamentals - EVM, smart contracts, wallets, on-chain settlement - or a strong appetite to go deep quickly What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs Our team is committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming interview experience for all candidates. items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Joining Mistral in APAC today means you’ll sit at the intersection of recruiting strategy and best practice execution at scale. TAs at Mistral get a seat at the table, deep influence in decision making, and are sparring partners to hiring managers. Your work will directly influence our success by ensuring we find and engage exceptional people who will drive Mistral’s growth. You will also foster a strong candidate experience to create a flywheel for our employer brand int he region. You will also help establish recruiting best practice by creating, documenting and scaling knowledge and playbooks. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! North integrates seamlessly with existing workflows, providing a trusted platform that connects AI agents with workplace tools and applications. WHY THIS ROLE? As a bridge between our core North product and our clients’ engineering teams, you’ll be at the forefront of solving complex problems and securely integrating AI into critical sectors such as finance, healthcare, and telecommunications. Our esteemed clients include industry leaders like RBC, Dell, and LG CNS. We are seeking engineers who deeply care about customers and want to work at the cutting edge of Agentic AI. items.title: Staff Engineer - Growth - Verifications
items.location_text: Brazil, Peru, Sweden, Colombia, Argentina, Romania, Malta, Slovenia, Lithuania, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Mexico, Chile, Poland, Bulgaria
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Pro Verifications team decides whether a business signing up on the Pro side is who it says it is, and whether we're allowed to onboard it. That means figuring out who actually owns the business, running it against sanctions and watchlists, and doing all of it fast enough that a real customer doesn't lose patience and leave. Every Pro customer hits these systems, so slow or wrong is very visible — and the team is early, which means whoever joins gets to decide how a lot of it works instead of inheriting it. How We Work - We deploy constantly, almost always behind a flag, in pieces small enough to pull back fast. - Security and compliance show up at design time, not as a gate at the end. - Every story is tied to a metric it's meant to move — if work isn't on the board, it doesn't get staffed. - At this level, you're expected to shape these standards, not just work inside them. THE OPPORTUNITY As a Staff Engineer on Pro Verifications, you'll own the technical direction for how verification is built here — the architecture, the patterns other engineers work inside, and the calls about what we own versus what we lean on a vendor for. You'll be hands-on across the stack, drive out entire classes of recurring failure rather than patching them one at a time, and design the fail-closed and audit behavior that keeps regulators satisfied. This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role for engineers who've built where being wrong has real consequences, and who want to shape a system that stays fast, safe, and defensible as it grows. - Set the shape of the verification services and their contracts across the KYC/KYB flow. - Decide how we abstract KYC and KYB vendors so a bad provider day doesn't turn into an outage. - Design fail-closed behavior and audit trails that hold up under regulatory scrutiny. - Identify the classes of failure that keep recurring and remove them for good. - Write and drive architecture decisions (ADRs), and hold the line on security and compliance at design time, not as a late gate. - Mentor and raise the bar for senior engineers through design reviews, code, and direct feedback. - Be measured on whether verification gets faster, more of it decides itself, fewer decisions are wrong, and the systems stay up — and on whether the team got stronger for you being on it. WHAT YOU BRING - Around eight years building and running production systems, with a track record of owning a domain's technical direction, not just delivering inside one. - Deep, fluent expertise in Rust, with the versatility to work across TypeScript and React where verification meets the customer. - You've set architecture other people build on, and it held up — you can point to specific classes of failure you designed out, not just incidents you fixed. - You've made teams faster through patterns, tooling, or mentoring — engineers around you got better and shipped more because of calls you made. - You've built where being wrong had real consequences: compliance, payments, security, or anywhere a bad call costs more than a rough user experience. - Strong on distributed systems, service contracts, and secure design — you've integrated third-party APIs that couldn't be trusted, with real timeouts, retries, idempotency, circuit breakers, and backup paths that actually get tested. - Comfortable with, or able to quickly ramp on, gRPC, Temporal, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, MySQL/MariaDB, Redis, and GitLab CI. NICE TO HAVES - Direct experience with KYC, KYB, or fraud work, including integrating providers like Trulioo, Persona, or ComplyAdvantage. - Comfort building with AI in the loop. - Time spent in crypto, fintech, or another space regulators pay close attention to. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. items.title: Compliance Manager
items.description: About Kambi Kambi Group plc is a leading B2B provider of premium sports betting services to licensed gaming operators. Our services provide an end-to-end solution for operators wanting to launch a standalone Sportsbook or bolster their existing offering with an innovative sports betting product. From front-end user interface to customer intelligence, risk management and odds compiling, all built on our in-house developed software, we strive to deliver the ultimate service and solution to our partners. Our vision is to create the world’s leading sports betting experiences, together with our partners. The team We’re looking for a Compliance Manager to join our award-winning Legal team as part of Kambi’s continued growth. You will be joining a team of nearly 30 people split across London and Malta, helping to provide support to the Kambi business globally. As a Compliance Manager, your day-to-day will look like: Manage end-to-end due diligence for new and existing clients/partners/suppliers, including intake, evidence collection, review, risk assessment, approval, recordkeeping and renewal. Monitor legal and gambling regulatory changes and provide updates to relevant stakeholders in the business. Own policy lifecycle management, including drafting, approvals, rollout, training/communications, and periodic monitoring and reviews to embed consistent controls across the business. Provide administrative support to Kambi’s Compliance Committee if/as required. Prepare and collate licensing submissions, such as forms and exhibits, to be used in gaming license application processes if/as required. Communicate and manage relationship with both regulatory authorities and key executives in the business if/as required. Support information management processes and resources related to licenses/registrations held by Kambi and update of software/systems used for managing license applications if/as required. Manage multiple projects/workstreams, prioritising in accordance with the business’ needs if/as required. Potentially manage one or more individuals within the team. You’ll be a great fit for the role if you have: Strong professional experience working within compliance/regulatory Experience with AML, ABC and Policy monitoring An AML qualification would also be highly beneficial Organised, proactive and with an excellent eye for detail Ability to work self-sufficiently and to tight deadlines on assigned tasks Strong communication skills An eagerness to learn Let’s talk about what’s in it for you? A friendly and supportive team Exposure to the global business Excellent company benefits including bonus and healthcare Hybrid working set up of 3 days in the office Kambi's ongoing commitment to Diversity and Inclusion in the workplace If you require any reasonable adjustment during the recruitment process, please notify your recruiter, who will assist you however they can. Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of who we are and who we aim to be. While we are proud of the positive and inclusive company culture we have created, we know we can do so much more. Kambi constantly evolves its Diversity and Inclusion strategy to ensure it becomes an even more inclusive and positive place to work, with the core management team reaffirming its commitment to delivering on employee feedback. Creating an inclusive environment We believe Kambi's greatest strength is the collective talent of our employees. Kambi is committed to ensuring we create an inclusive work environment where everyone can feel valued, thrive and achieve their potential, regardless of who they are or what their background is. We know that it is only by having a balance of different voices, values and opinions that Kambi is able to be the market leader it is today. #wearekambi

items.description: Scale’s rapidly growing International Public Sector team is focused on using AI to address critical challenges facing the public sector around the world. Our core work consists of: Creating custom AI applications that will impact millions of citizens Generating high-quality training data for custom LLMs Upskilling and advisory services to spread the impact of AI As a Full Stack Software Engineer (Forward Deployed), you’ll collaborate directly with public sector counterparts to quickly build full-stack, AI applications, to solve their most pressing challenges and achieve meaningful impact for citizens. At Scale, we’re not just building AI solutions—we’re enabling the public sector to transform their operations and better serve citizens through cutting-edge technology. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI in the public sector and be a founding member of our team, we’d love to hear from you. You will: Serve as the lead technical strategist for public sector engagements, converting ambiguous mission requirements into robust architectural roadmaps and guiding onsite implementation Architect the fundamental frameworks for production-grade AI applications, setting the gold standard for how interactive UIs, backend systems, and AI models are integrated at scale to deliver reliable outcomes. Guide the evolution of cloud infrastructure, ensuring security, global scalability, and long-term system integrity across all environments. Direct the development of core platforms and shared services, ensuring they solve cross-cutting needs for diverse global client use cases. Partner with cross-functional leadership to steer the technical roadmap, mentoring senior and junior staff and ensuring all products align with a cohesive, future-proof technical architecture. Bridge the gap between the field and the core platform by turning real-world client lessons into the reusable patterns that power the entire engineering team. Ideally you’d have: Masters or Phd in Computer Science or equivalent deep industry experience in architecting complex, distributed systems. 10+ years of full-stack expertise across Python, Node.js, and React, with a proven track record of designing high-scale architectures on Kubernetes and global cloud infrastructures (AWS/Azure/GCP). Expert ability to design and oversee production-grade ecosystems, ensuring world-class standards for system integrity, security, and long-term scalability. Extensive experience deploying and troubleshooting sophisticated end-to-end solutions directly within complex, high-security client environments. Proven track record of building LLM-driven solutions with the strategic foresight to anticipate landscape shifts and architect future-proof systems. A self-driven leader capable of resolving extreme ambiguity, mentoring senior staff, and setting the technical vision for the organization. A driver of asynchronous workflows and documentation-first cultures to streamline global engineering velocity and reduce friction. Nice to haves: Past experience working at a startup as a CTO or founding engineer or in a forward deployed engineer / dedicated customer engineer role Experience working cross functionally with operations Proficient in Arabic For those applying based in Qatar: Residency and employment in Qatar requires certain permissions (visa and permits) issued by the Qatari authorities. items.title: Account Director, Digital Natives
items.description: About the team OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this. In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible. About the role Our Sales team has a unique mission to help customers understand the deep impact that highly capable AI models can bring to their business and users. This role is a mixture of technical understanding, vision, partnership, and value-driven strategy. You’ll be a key driver of opportunities through the entire sales cycle, from pipeline generation to closure. You’ll work with researchers, engineers, and solution strategists to help customers evolve their industry with AI. This role can be based in Delhi or Mumbai In this role, you'll: - Manage a portfolio of customer accounts, developing and executing strategies for a comprehensive account plan - Support your customer accounts from initial engagement to successful deployment and through to renewal - Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects - Own a revenue target - Manage revenue forecasts - Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders - Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies - Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering - Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates - Support the development of company culture We're seeking someone with experience including: - 7+ years selling and renewing platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service - Designing and executing complex deal strategies - Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies - Working directly with c-level executives - Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders - Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence You might thrive in this role if you: - Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor. - Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future. - Are a builder. You are excited to impact how our company operates and scales. Your passion is building strong systems and processes from the ground up and executing them with precision. - Are excited by new challenges. You don’t have the answers to every question up front, but the process of solving them invigorates you. Bespoke issues requiring multidimensional knowledge excite you. items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We're seeking an experienced Executive Escalations Manager to be a founding member of a new pillar of our Operations organization: Community & Executive Escalations. This role is the front line of how Anthropic protects its reputation when high-stakes user issues surface through executive channels. You'll help stand up the function from scratch and operate it day-to-day. You'll be the person building the playbooks and escalation criteria, triaging incoming escalations, and running them to resolution alongside cross-functional partners. The ideal candidate combines calm-under-fire judgment with sharp written communication and a bias toward action. Responsibilities: Build the team's playbooks, escalation criteria, tooling solutions, and SOPs to successfully manage escalations coming from Anthropic’s executive team Own executive escalations end-to-end during your coverage hours Communicate crisply with internal stakeholders: brief executives on live situations, give Comms partners the facts they need, and keep incident channels useful and current Write clear post-escalation reports that capture what happened, what we did, and what should change—so the next escalation is easier than the last Lead a recurring escalations insights forum: identify patterns across escalations and drive the resulting product and policy changes with partner teams You may be a good fit if you have: 6+ years of experience in escalation management, trust & safety operations, customer support, or a related front-line operations role—ideally at a consumer or developer platform. Direct, hands-on experience running incidents or escalations: you've been the person investigating the issue, coordinating R&R with XFN partners, and writing executive comms. Sharp written communication—you can brief a senior leader in three sentences and document an incident so the next responder can pick it up cold Excellent judgment under pressure Comfort coordinating across functions in real time and influencing partners without positional authority A pattern-detection mindset—you spot the second-order issue beneath the first-order complaint and surface it to the right people Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action; this team is brand new and you'll be helping define what good looks like as you operate Excitement about protecting Anthropic's reputation and relationships at a moment when public attention on AI has never been higher The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $210,000 — $260,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. items.title: Staff Quantitative Researcher
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. The Investment Strategy team is expanding access to sophisticated investment advice by turning high-quality portfolio management into a scalable, intuitive experience for everyday customers. Sitting at the intersection of markets, product, and customer experience, our team combines rigorous investment thinking with a mobile-first product design. We are dedicated to building accessible investing tools that reach and support millions of people! As a Staff Quantitative Researcher , you will report to the Chief Investment Officer and play a key role in shaping our investment product offerings. In this role, you will build complex portfolio construction factor models, identify critical areas for methodology improvement, and design high-performing investment solutions. You will also collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal to launch these products and bring them directly to our customers. This role is based in our New York, NY office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Partner with the Chief Investment Officer and investment leadership to develop, refine, and maintain complex portfolio construction models. Work with large datasets, including unconventional data sources, to predict and test statistical market patterns, conceptualize valuation strategies, and improve mathematical models. Backtest and implement financial models and signals in a live trading environment. Continuously research and analyze new approaches to building portfolio models, applying knowledge of existing and emerging quantitative finance principles, theories, and techniques to inform investment decisions. Partner with product and engineering teams to help design and execute on complex projects and product launches. Assist with reviews by Legal & Compliance to develop written policies and procedures when new features are introduced or methodology changes are developed. What you bring 5+ years of quantitative research, quantitative portfolio construction, or machine learning experience, ideally within asset management, a broker-dealer, an RIA, or broader financial services. Experience taking machine learning models, research, or quantitative signals into a live investing or production environment. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL for quantitative modeling, statistical analysis, and working with large-scale datasets. Strong grounding in statistics, machine learning algorithms, and pattern recognition. Outstanding communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex modeling, statistical, or investment concepts for software engineering, product, and compliance partners. Comfort with ambiguity, high personal ownership, and the ability to work independently to deliver on critical business milestones. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $217,000 — $255,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $191,000 — $224,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $170,000 — $199,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Product Designer, Youth
items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Youth team is focused on making AI safe, useful, and empowering for young people. Our work spans foundational protections—including age assurance and always-on safety—as well as new learning and education experiences. We’re also exploring how OpenAI’s technology can support K–12 schools, educators, classrooms, and collaborative learning. About the Role We’re looking for a staff-level product designer to shape how young people safely engage with AI and help define OpenAI’s emerging education experiences. You’ll work across immediate product needs and ambitious zero-to-one opportunities, from age-appropriate safety systems to tools for learning and group work. A high craft bar is imperative. You’ll be expected to pair exceptional interaction and visual design with deep product thinking—turning complex questions around safety, learning, and institutional needs into experiences that feel clear, trustworthy, and engaging. This is a highly generative role for someone who can move from early exploration to concrete, high-fidelity product direction. You’ll partner closely with product, engineering, research, safety, policy, and design to establish durable patterns for a space that is still being defined. This role is based in our San Francisco HQ. We offer relocation assistance to new employees. In this role you will: - Establish an exceptionally high standard for craft across OpenAI’s youth and education experiences. - Lead end-to-end design for products that help young people use AI safely, confidently, and productively. - Design clear, age-appropriate experiences for safety, age assurance, and other sensitive or high-trust interactions. - Shape zero-to-one K–12 experiences spanning school districts, educators, classrooms, collaborative work, and builder-style workflows. - Turn emerging ideas into compelling concepts, prototypes, and high-fidelity product experiences that teams can evaluate and build. - Partner with research, engineering, product, safety, policy, and design to balance user needs, technical capabilities, and responsible deployment. - Conduct and apply research with relevant users and partners to understand the needs of young people, educators, and institutions. - Develop reusable patterns and principles that create coherence across youth and education products as the area grows. You might thrive in this role if you: - Bring exceptional interaction and visual design craft and are motivated to raise the quality of design across OpenAI. - Are a highly generative designer who explores broadly, iterates deeply, and turns ideas into concrete, polished product direction. - Pair strong craft with deep product and systems thinking. - Have led substantial, ambiguous, or zero-to-one product areas and can help shape both vision and execution. - Can design thoughtful experiences for sensitive, high-trust, or safety-critical contexts. - Understand how to create products that are engaging and intuitive without compromising safety or clarity. - Can navigate the needs of multiple audiences, including young people, educators, administrators, and institutional partners. - Communicate clearly, build alignment across disciplines, and remain hands-on throughout the product-development process. - Are energized by the opportunity to define how AI can support learning while serving young people responsibly. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. Background checks for applicants will be administered in accordance with applicable law, and qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment consistent with those laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act, for US-based candidates. For unincorporated Los Angeles County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: protect computer hardware entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon termination of employment or end of assignment; and maintain the confidentiality of proprietary, confidential, and non-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. To notify OpenAI that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form https://form.asana.com/?d=57018692298241&k=5MqR40fZd7jlxVUh5J-UeA. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this link https://form.asana.com/?k=bQ7w9h3iexRlicUdWRiwvg&d=57018692298241. OpenAI Global Applicant Privacy Policy https://cdn.openai.com/policies/global-employee-and-contractor-privacy-policy.pdf At OpenAI, we believe artificial intelligence has the potential to help people solve immense global challenges, and we want the upside of AI to be widely shared. Join us in shaping the future of technology.

items.title: Applied AI Engineer, Australia
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE As a Applied AI Engineer on the Applied AI team, you will bridge the gap between Mistral’s cutting-edge AI research and real-world enterprise applications. This role exists to ensure our solutions are robust, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Mistral’s technological vision. The Applied AI team is Mistral’s customer-facing technical organization, working directly with enterprise clients from pre-sales through implementation. We combine deep machine learning expertise with strong customer engagement, operating like startup CTOs who own end-to-end project execution. By joining this team, you will drive the adoption of Mistral’s products, helping customers deploy AI solutions that deliver measurable business impact across industries. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Deploy production-ready AI use cases with significant business impact across diverse industries. - Develop state-of-the-art GenAI applications, from consumer products to industrial solutions, driving technological transformation for customers. - Collaborate with researchers, AI engineers, and product teams on complex customer projects involving fine-tuning, advanced LLM applications, and contributions to open-source codebases. - Participate in pre-sales calls to understand client needs, challenges, and aspirations, providing technical guidance on Mistral’s products. - Work with product and science teams to continuously improve model and product capabilities based on customer feedback. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Fluency in English. - Experience as a technical individual contributor (data scientist or software engineer) on AI-based products. - Proven track record in implementing AI or machine learning products with APIs, back-end, and front-end interfaces. - Hands-on experience with fine-tuning LLMs, advanced RAG, or agentic use cases. - Deep understanding of machine learning and LLM concepts and algorithms. - Strong technical coding skills in Python. - Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Contributions to open-source projects, particularly in the LLM space. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.
